USAGE: firmwarekit create [<options>] --ipsw <ipsw> --out <out>

OPTIONS:
  --entry <entry>         The catalog entry, as JSON.
  --catalog <catalog>     A catalog, with --id.
  --id <id>               The entry's id in --catalog.
  --ipsw <ipsw>
  --out <out>             The staging directory.
  --seed <seed>
  --helper <helper>       LightTouchDevice, for the one-shot boots (default:
                          the one beside firmwarekit).
  --cache <cache>         The decrypt cache.
  --guest-tools <guest-tools>
                          Default: the app bundle's packed guest tools.
  --sibling-entry <sibling-entry>
                          recipe.keybag_ramdisk_from's entry.
  --sibling-ipsw <sibling-ipsw>
  --stop-after <stop-after>
  --gl-test               Adds the GL fixture job to a test device.
  --skip-setup            Seeds Setup Assistant's finished state (iOS 5 and
                          later): the device starts at the Home screen.
  --jailbreak             Prepares the device jailbroken: afc2 (the whole file
                          system over USB), Cydia and Substrate.
  --version               Show the version.
  -h, --help              Show help information.
